title: nan
authors: Matiki T.; Narazaki Y.; Chowdhary G.; Spencer B.F., Jr.
key_contribution: Presents an updatable graphics-based digital twin approach with adaptive neural pose regression for robust absolute UAV localization in GPS-denied civil infrastructure, validated on a custom drone.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
